messages:
Marta: Kicking off Venus Health onboarding (trial). Key asks: private deployment + KMS for keys. Plan: 30-day activation with data residency checks. Owners + short timeline below.

Owen: I'll own infra setup for Private (VPC peering + routing). Will need VPC CIDR and peering window from their infra.

Lina: I'll do data mapping and ingestion. Note: if PII fields appear we must enable field-level redaction. Ask Venus to flag sensitive fields in sample.

Devon: I'll handle enablement + ops runbook. Propose a 30-min workshop Day 2 focused on private deployment steps.

Kiran: Security/KMS lead here. For KMS integration we need their KMS ARN and access policy; eng-security will review. This can add 2-3 days if we need HSM support.

Marta: Compact timeline:
1) Day0: Access & contract sign (Marta)
2) Day1-3: VPC peering + infra prep (Owen)
3) Day2: Enablement workshop (Devon)
4) Day3-7: Ingest + schema map (Lina)
5) Day5-12: KMS + security review (Kiran)
6) Day10-20: Canary + perf baseline (Owen/Lina)
7) Day14: NPS pulse + quality check (Marta)
8) Day21-30: Go/no-go & renewal signal (Marta)

Marta: Success criteria: activation = prod queries >= 80/day AND 90th_lat <700ms by Day30. If KMS integration delayed >7d mark as elevated renewal risk.

Devon: Enablement agenda: private deployment checklist, certs & keys, ingress rules, canary traffic plan, rollback. Will post slides.

Owen: If peering window slips, fallback is temporary VPN tunnel but note perf impact. Marking as contingency.

Kiran: Eng-security ticket requested: provide IAM policy draft. If HSM required, add 3 business days.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Venus Onboard - Workshop" Day2 14:00 PT invitees: Marta, Owen, Lina, Devon, Kiran, Venus PM.

Marta: Please accept invites and update tracker with any blockers. Short updates only here so we have a single source of truth. Thanks.
